cases.companion_yaml:
language_compatibility: hermes-legacy
required_services: [git]
tags: [conformance]
outward_action_nodes: [prepare]
outward_action_policy: approval_required
overlap_policy: queue
pause_lane_policy: hold
required_secrets: [FIXTURE_TOKEN]
cases.definition_yaml:
name: field-families
description: Conformance fixture for field-families.
provider: openrouter
model: small
modelReasoningEffort: high
webSearchMode: auto
interactive: false
requires: [git]
worktree: {enabled: false}
tags: [conformance]
persist_sessions: false
effort: high
thinking: adaptive
fallbackModel: medium
betas: [fixture]
sandbox: {enabled: false}
nodes:
  - id: prepare
    prompt: Prepare.
    retry: {max_attempts: 1, delay_ms: 1000, on_error: transient}
    provider: openrouter
    model: small
    allowed_tools: [read_file]
    denied_tools: [terminal]
    skills: [review]
    agents:
      reviewer:
        description: Review the result.
        prompt: Check the result.
        model: medium
        tools: [read_file]
        disallowedTools: [terminal]
        skills: [review]
        maxTurns: 2
    hooks:
      PreToolUse:
        - matcher: ^read_file$
          timeout: 30
          response:
            continue: true
            systemMessage: Keep the operation bounded.
            hookSpecificOutput:
              hookEventName: PreToolUse
              permissionDecision: allow
              permissionDecisionReason: Fixture policy.
              updatedInput: {path: safe.txt}
              additionalContext: Fixture context.
  - id: repeat
    loop:
      prompt: Try again.
      until: done
      max_iterations: 2
  - id: approve
    approval:
      message: Continue?
      capture_response: true
      on_reject:
        prompt: Revise.
        max_attempts: 2
  - id: finish
    depends_on: [prepare, repeat, approve]
    bash: printf done
    trigger_rule: all_done
    context: fresh
    always_run: true
    timeout: 1

name: legacy-loop-group
description: Conformance fixture for legacy-loop-group.
nodes:
  - id: group
    loop_group:
      until: done
      max_iterations: 1
      nodes:
        - id: child
          prompt: Work.

name: legacy-artifacts
description: Conformance fixture for legacy-artifacts.
nodes:
  - id: process
    bash: printf ok
    artifacts: false

name: legacy-unknown-field
description: Conformance fixture for legacy-unknown-field.
future_editor_field: {preserve: exactly}
nodes:
  - id: work
    prompt: Work.
